about: Lines a DOSBox-X build sent over the debugger channel in a live session of this server, verbatim: protocol 3 from the fork's debugger-presence-command at 158f511fa, protocol 3 with the record mark from the same branch at ceddc7af2 (`protocol3_record`), protocol 2 from the build the scry link points at. The `refused_record_*` lines are what 158f511fa answers to the record mark's words, which is why a build without the mark is not sent them.
